Oracle workforce falls by 21,000 amid AI adoption push

Oracle has cut around 21,000 jobs in the past year, citing the impact of artificial intelligence on workforce needs. The company’s latest filing shows declining headcount even as it invests heavily in AI infrastructure and expands cloud competition globally
